meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要从命令行制作演示动画
copy.tagline_en: Create and render presentation animations from the command line.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to build presentations programmatically.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能通过 HyperFrames 命令行工具，帮你搭建视频项目、检查质量、预览效果，并在你批准后渲染成视频。它也支持云端渲染、批量渲染和提交反馈。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行视频项目的创建、检查、渲染等开发流程，或需要排查构建/渲染失败时，会触发此技能。

say.text: 帮我用 HyperFrames 初始化一个项目，示例选 welcome。
对当前项目运行 check，并通过 preview 打开预览。
say.note: check 会先执行 lint，然后打开浏览器预览。

say.text: 用 draft 质量快速渲染一遍作为迭代版本。
say.note: 会生成一个用于迭代的视频文件。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude drive the HyperFrames CLI to scaffold video projects, run checks and previews, and render final videos. It also supports cloud rendering, batch jobs, and feedback submission.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests HyperFrames development tasks such as creating, checking, rendering, or diagnosing build/render failures. Covers local, HeyGen cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run.

say_en.text: Initialize a HyperFrames project with the welcome example.
Run check on this project and open the preview.
say_en.note: Runs lint then opens browser preview.

say_en.text: Render a draft-quality version for quick iteration.
